neighbours.label: The first piece of a split word whose ending is predictable from context: ' arch' of 'archipelago' and ' horn' of 'horned (owl)'; the same places and animals described without those words stay quiet.
fire: Indonesia is the largest archipelago on Earth.
A great horned owl nested in the barn.
The ferry crosses the archipelago twice a week.
The horned lizard squirts blood from its eyes.
Stockholm sits at the edge of an archipelago.
We heard a great horned owl calling at dusk.
The archipelago has over a thousand islands.
Horned vipers hide in the desert sand.
quiet: Indonesia is the largest island nation on Earth.
A barn owl nested in the barn.
The ferry crosses the bay twice a week.
The spiny lizard hides under rocks.
Stockholm sits at the edge of the sea.
We heard a tawny owl calling at dusk.
The country has over a thousand islands.
Desert vipers hide in the sand.

notes: Card: ' arch' x9, ' horn' x2 (great⟦ horn⟧ed owl), ' Arch' x2, '-cl' (bush-clad); auto test held (AUROC 1.00) for ' arch' right before 'ipel'. Tokenizer: arch|ipel|ago, horn|ed. Exploratory probe: 'a large archipelago' 0.75, 'great horned owl' 0.80; 'thousands of islands' 0.02, 'great grey owl' 0.05.
